tasks.verified: Six full-envelope week-anaphora replays on v120 captured under env1..env6, so the wrong-Monday rate and the exact search variables on any bad run are measured, not guessed.
tasks.spec: python3 -c "import json;json.dump(['hi', \"I'm out this week how about in two weeks?\", 'What about Monday that week?'],open('turns.json','w'))"; ok=0; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do CAPTURE_TURNS="$(cat turns.json)" HARNESS_PATIENT_ID=4376662466 HARNESS_PATIENT_CELL=6468942428 HARNESS_STORE=711 python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/checks/capture_envelope.py 120 env$i > cap$i.txt 2>&1 && ok=$((ok+1)); grep -m1 'TURN=3' cap$i.txt | head -c 200; echo; done; echo CAPTURES_OK=$ok; [ "$ok" -eq 6 ]
tasks.check: grep -q 'CAPTURES_OK=6' <(tail -2 cap6.txt; echo CAPTURES_OK_MARKER) 2>/dev/null; n=0; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do grep -q 'CAPTURE_COMPLETE' cap$i.txt && n=$((n+1)); done; [ "$n" -eq 6 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n/6 captures completed"; exit 1; }; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do d=$(grep -oE '08/(10|17)/2026' cap$i.txt | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' ); echo "RUN$i dates=$d"; done; echo 'PASS: 6/6 envelope captures complete'
